A short colored motif is shown once, with its anchor position identified by a distinct marker color elsewhere in the grid; each marker is replaced by a copy of the motif aligned at that anchor, preserving the motif exemplar. Demo 1: motif [5,6,6] horizontal, marker color 1 denotes anchor at motif index 1; markers at (r0,c2),(r0,c7),(r2,c1),(r2,c8) become copies starting one column left, with exemplar [5,6,6] at row10 retained. Demo 2: exemplar [3,3,3,5,0] row1 c0-4; marker 2 at (2,8),(9,8) aligns with template index 2 (color3), so copies start c6 and exemplar stays. Test variant: vertical template [8,3,0], anchor at center 3; each 6 marker replaced by vertical 8/3/0 centered on it; do not leave markers. Respect bounds and maintain other background cells. General rule: locate seed/template and special marker color, infer anchor alignment, stamp template at every marker, retain original template.' )
print(state)
